verdict.rationale: Undermind's only recurring automation is its own topic monitoring: it notifies users when relevant papers are published and offers enterprise 'role-aware alerts' that monitor saved topics and send updates. This is a fixed, product-defined recurring job, not a general ability to schedule arbitrary jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined schedules or cadence controls, scheduling of arbitrary research workflows (e.g., recurring deep reviews or API/MCP-triggered runs), documentation of how monitoring is configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
